cohort: 109,932 women with singleton pregnancies attending their first routine hospital visit at 11 + 0 to 13 + 6 weeks' gestation
finding: Chronic hypertension during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of stillbirth, pre-eclampsia, small-for-gestational-age neonates, gestational diabetes mellitus, iatrogenic preterm birth, and elective Cesarean section, and a decreased risk of large-for-gestational-age neonates.
